semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides specialized testing and measurement equipment for semiconductor chips and related services.
summary: NanoVis Electronics Technologies (China) Limited specializes in high-end semiconductor measurement and testing equipment, including failure analysis and finished product testing. They serve as the exclusive agent for several international semiconductor equipment suppliers and provide technical support services across China.
capabilities: Power and discrete device testers for MOSFETs and diodes
Silicon wafer manufacturing process reliability testers
High-precision measurement systems for semiconductor manufacturing
Automatic chemical and laser unpacking machines for plastic-encapsulated devices

regional_presence.China: The company has a strong presence across China with sales and service points in major cities including Shanghai, Beijing, Chengdu, Wuhan, and Wuxi.
